entities.summary: Ralph de Diceto or Ralph of Diss was archdeacon of Middlesex, dean of St Paul's Cathedral, and the author of a major chronicle divided into two parts—often treated as separate works—the Abbreviationes Chronicorum from the birth of Jesus to the 1140s and the Imagines or Ymagines Historiarum from that point until 1202.
